name: Muscle Mommy Island
source:
Follow the adventures of the recently retired Greg as he goes on vacation to the Caribbean island of Bamaso, a place where it's 25c and has snow falls year round. He gets a lot more than his moneys worth on his retirement vacation as he meets the rather large locals and other vacation goers in this unique Visual novel. 

[From [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/muscle-mommy-island]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随刚刚退休的格雷格前往加勒比海的巴马索岛度假冒险吧——那是一座气温保持在25℃却终年飘雪的奇妙岛屿。在这部别具一格的视觉小说里，他在退休假期中结识了体型相当高大健硕的当地居民与其他度假游客，收获了远超票价的惊奇艳遇。

[摘自[url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/muscle-mommy-island]itch.io[/url]]
